arxiv-2205-04489.description: Abstract . We show that if Y Y is a compact Riemannian manifold with improved L q L^{q} eigenfunction estimates then, at least for large enough exponents, one always obtains improved L q L^{q} bounds on the product manifold X × Y X\times Y if X X is another compact manifold.

arxiv-2210-15584.title: The statistical theory of the angiogenesis equations
arxiv-2210-15584.creator: Björn Birnir
arxiv-2210-15584.description: Abstract Angiogenesis is a multiscale process by which a primary blood vessel issues secondary vessel sprouts that reach regions lacking oxygen. Angiogenesis can be a natural process of organ growth and development or a pathological induced by a cancerous tumor.

arxiv-2311-15117.title: Resilience-driven Planning of Electric Power Systems Against Extreme Weather Events
arxiv-2311-15117.creator: Abodh Poudyal † , Shishir Lamichhane, and Anamika Dubey, Josue Campos do Prado
arxiv-2311-15117.description: Abstract With the increasing frequency of natural disasters, operators must prioritize improvements in the existing electric power grid infrastructure to enhance the resilience of the grid. Resilience to extreme weather events necessitates lowering the impacts of high-impact, low-probability (HILP) events, which is only possible when such events are considered during the planning stage.

arxiv-2406-07144.title: Ion Energy Tuning for Enhanced sp 3 Carbon Fraction in Electron Cyclotron Resonance Ion Beam Deposited Diamond-Like Carbon Coatings: a Computational and Experimental Approach Journal: Diamond and Related Materials
arxiv-2406-07144.creator: Callum Wiseman a,1 , Marwa Ben Yaala a,1,2 , Chalisa Gier a , Laurent Marot b , Christopher McCormick a , Sheila Rowan c and Stuart Reid a
arxiv-2406-07144.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Callum Wiseman a,1 , Marwa Ben Yaala a,1,2 , Chalisa Gier a , Laurent Marot b , Christopher McCormick a , Sheila Rowan c and Stuart Reid a. A novel high-energy electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) ion beam deposition (IBD) technique was used to fabricate DLC films at different ion beam energies.

arxiv-2406-18423.title: Graph Neural Networks for Emulation of Finite-Element Ice Dynamics in Greenland and Antarctic Ice Sheets
arxiv-2406-18423.creator: Younghyun Koo, Maryam Rahnemoonfar
arxiv-2406-18423.description: Abstract Although numerical models provide accurate solutions for ice sheet dynamics based on physics laws, they accompany intensified computational demands to solve partial differential equations. In recent years, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been widely used as statistical emulators for those numerical models.

arxiv-2412-02030.title: NitroFusion: High-Fidelity Single-Step Diffusion through Dynamic Adversarial Training
arxiv-2412-02030.creator: Dar-Yen Chen Hmrishav Bandyopadhyay Kai Zou Yi-Zhe Song
arxiv-2412-02030.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dar-Yen Chen Hmrishav Bandyopadhyay Kai Zou Yi-Zhe Song. We introduce NitroFusion, a fundamentally different approach to single-step diffusion that achieves high-quality generation through a dynamic adversarial framework. While one-step methods offer dramatic speed advantages, they typically suffer from quality degradation compared to their multi-step counterparts. Just as a panel of art critics provides comprehensive feedback by specializing in different aspects like composition, color, and technique, our approach maintains a large pool of specialized discriminator heads that collectively guide the generation process.

arxiv-2505-17028.title: Turbulent Snow Transport and Accumulation: New Reduced-Order Models and Diagnostics
arxiv-2505-17028.creator: Nikolas O. Aksamit, Alex P. Encinas-Bartos, Holt Hancock, Alexander Prokop
arxiv-2505-17028.description: Abstract Understanding and modeling snow particle dynamics in the atmosphere remains a significant challenge for atmospheric scientists, hydrologists, and glaciologists. Temporally and spatially varying rates of snow transport, deposition, and erosion are driven by atmospheric turbulence and further complicated by inertial particle dynamics.

arxiv-2512-02282.title: DialogGuard: Multi-Agent Psychosocial Safety Evaluation of Sensitive LLM Responses CCS: Information systems Web applications CCS: Human-centered computing Human computer interaction (HCI) CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language processing CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI
arxiv-2512-02282.creator: Han Luo, Guy Laban
arxiv-2512-02282.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) now mediate many web-based mental-health, crisis, and other emotionally sensitive services, yet their psychosocial safety in these settings remains poorly understood and weakly evaluated. We present DialogGuard, a multi-agent framework for assessing psychosocial risks in LLM-generated responses along five high-severity dimensions: privacy violations, discriminatory behaviour, mental manipulation, psychological harm, and insulting behaviour.

arxiv-2602-14652.title: Temporally Flexible Transport Scheduling on Networks with Departure-Arrival Constriction and Nodal Capacity Limits
arxiv-2602-14652.creator: Anqi Dong, Karl H. Johansson, Johan Karlsson
arxiv-2602-14652.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Anqi Dong, Karl H. Johansson, Johan Karlsson. We investigate the optimal transport (OT) problem over networks, wherein supply and demand are conceptualized as temporal marginals governing departure rates of particles from source nodes and arrival rates at sink nodes. This setting extends the classical OT framework, where all mass is conventionally assumed to depart at t = 0 t=0 and arrive at t = t f t=t_{f} . Our generalization accommodates departures and arrivals at specified times, referred as departure–arrival (DA) constraints.

pmc-10607948.title: A C-Arm-Free Minimally Invasive Technique for Spinal Surgery: Cervical and Thoracic Spine
pmc-10607948.creator: Masato Tanaka, Konstantinos Zygogiannnis, Naveen Sake, Shinya Arataki, Yoshihiro Fujiwara, Takuya Taoka, Thiago Henrique de Moraes Modesto, Ioannis Chatzikomninos, Anwen Shao
pmc-10607948.description: Background and Objectives: C-arm-free MIS techniques can offer significantly reduced rates of postoperative complications such as inadequate decompression, blood loss, and instrumentation misplacement. Another advantageous long-term aspect is the notably diminished exposure to radiation, which is known to cause malignant changes.

pmc-11445862.title: In vitro drug testing using patient-derived ovarian cancer organoids
pmc-11445862.creator: Lin-Yu Chen, Yu-Ting Chou, Phui-Ly Liew, Ling-Hui Chu, Kuo-Chang Wen, Shiou-Fu Lin, Yu-Chun Weng, Hui-Chen Wang, Po-Hsuan Su, Hung-Cheng Lai
pmc-11445862.description: BackgroundOvarian cancer is the most lethal gynecological cancer. As the primary treatment, chemotherapy has a response rate of only 60–70% in advanced stages, and even lower as a second-line treatment. Despite guideline recommendations, which drugs will be most effective remains unclear. Thus, a strategy to prioritize chemotherapy options is urgently needed.

pmc-11568833.title: A Comprehensive Review of Recent Trends in Surgical Approaches for Epilepsy Management
pmc-11568833.creator: Tara Sabzvari, Muhammed Aflahe Iqbal, Akash Ranganatha, Jean C Daher, Isabel Freire, Syeda Maham Fatima Shamsi, Oriona Vinishia Paul Anthony, Anusha G Hingorani, Aparita S Sinha, Zahra Nazir
pmc-11568833.description: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder that affects millions of people worldwide, with a significant proportion of patients experiencing drug-resistant epilepsy, where seizures remain uncontrolled despite medical treatment. This review evaluates the latest surgical techniques for managing epilepsy, focusing on their effectiveness, safety, and the ongoing challenges that hinder their broader adoption.

pmc-11691115.title: MENOPAUSE HISTORY AND COGNITIVE FUNCTION IN THE IGNITE TRIAL
pmc-11691115.creator: Amber Watts, Shannon Donofry, Hayley Ripperger, Nicole Eklund, Lu Wan, Chaeryon Kang, Kirk Erickson
pmc-11691115.description: Lifetime exposure to estrogen, a neuroprotectant, is associated with cognitive aging and dementia. Surgically induced menopause (ovariectomy) is associated with poorer cognitive performance, while use of hormone therapy (e.g., birth control, menopausal hormone therapy) has shown mixed associations with cognitive performance. We investigated these associations in IGNITE, a 12-month, multi-site, randomized exercise trial.

pmc-12532860.title: Effects of different transcranial magnetic stimulation coil types on phosphene thresholds and their association with motor cortex excitability
pmc-12532860.creator: Halit Fidancı, Halil Can Alaydın, Cemre Cöddü, İrem Yakıcı, Zülfikar Arlıer
pmc-12532860.description: BackgroundPhosphenes can be induced by applying transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) to the visual cortex. Since multiple factors influence phosphene perception, this study aimed to examine the effects of different TMS coil types on phosphene thresholds (PTs). Additionally, the relationship between PT and motor cortex excitability was explored.

pmc-12619596.title: Hydroxysafflor Yellow A Reduced Neuroinflammation Induced by Astrocyte-Derived IL-17A by Inhibiting the IL-17RA/ACT1/NF-κB/IL-17A Loop After OGD/R
pmc-12619596.creator: Lijuan Song, Jianlin Hua, Kexin Liu, Yanzhe Duan, Yukang Sun, Jiezhong Yu, Jinzhu Yin, Cungen Ma, Baoguo Xiao, Dong Ma, Jianjun Huang
pmc-12619596.description: IntroductionNeuroinflammation induced by astrocytes has garnered significant attention recently. The IL-17A/IL-17RA signal pathway plays an important role in ischemic stroke (IS). Hydroxysafflor yellow A (HSYA) has been reported to have anti-apoptotic and anti-inflammatory properties that can protect neurons. In this study, we explore a novel mechanism that underlies the anti-apoptotic and anti-inflammatory effects of HSYA.

pmc-12763899.title: Bedside needle arthroscopy for native joint bacterial arthritis in a real-world clinical practice setting: a prospective cohort study
pmc-12763899.creator: Alex B. Walinga, Stein J. Janssen, Tobias Stornebrink, Rover Krips, Sander W. Tas, Arthur J. Kievit, Gino M.M.J. Kerkhoffs
pmc-12763899.description: BackgroundBacterial (i.e., septic) arthritis requires prompt source control, including drainage of the infected synovial fluid, often through arthrocentesis (needle aspiration) or surgical intervention, in combination with antibiotics to prevent joint damage; however, when surgical intervention is required, conventional arthroscopy can lead to treatment delays and anesthesia-related complications.

pmc-13119242.title: Screening and Evaluation In Vitro of Bacillus-Based Probiotics for Feed Additives
pmc-13119242.creator: Yujun Mao, Xiaofang Lou, Jianmei Che, Xiaoyun Huang, Yanping Chen, Jianglin Lan, Meichun Chen, Xin Liu, Qinlou Huang, Xiusheng Huang, Jieping Wang
pmc-13119242.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In the post-antibiotic era, the Bacillus-based direct-fed beneficial microorganisms are emerging as a cornerstone for sustainable animal farming. This study aimed to screen and evaluate Bacillus strains with probiotic potential for use as feed additives. A total of 394 Bacillus strains were initially screened based on their extracellular enzyme production (cellulase, protease, and amylase) and antibacterial activities against Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Salmonella enterica.

pmc-13479580.title: Epineuronal space: an emerging hidden hierarchy bridges neuron and mind space
pmc-13479580.creator: Yi-Xi Zhang, Qiang-Long You, Xiang-Dong Sun
pmc-13479580.description: The emergent nature of life hinders reductionist paradigms of mapping microscale fundamental components with macroscale phenotypes. Such dilemma of mapping problems can be resolved through seeking hidden hierarchies among them. In developmental biology, the introduction of epigenotype highlighting developmental tissue scale interactions bridges the gap between phenotype and genotype, providing an instance for coping with mapping problems.

pmc-13572300.title: Anatomical location defines distinct molecular subtypes of mucosal melanoma
pmc-13572300.creator: E.-R. Zhou, J. Rusheen, R. Baumann, S. Ariyan, H.M. Kluger, S. Gabizon-Peretz
pmc-13572300.description: BackgroundMucosal melanoma (MM) is a rare and aggressive melanoma subtype that is understudied. The relationships between anatomical location, genomic alterations, stage at presentation, and survival remain incompletely characterized.MethodsWe carried out a retrospective single tertiary center study of 105 patients with histologically confirmed MM diagnosed between 1996 and 2025.
